_comment: Weekly redesign pipeline settings. Prices are USD per 1M tokens; verify against https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing when changing models.

pricing._comment: Billing is conservative: cached input is charged at the full input rate, thinking tokens at the output rate. Any model not listed is charged at the 'fallback' rate.

preapprovedPackages._comment: Packages a design may depend on WITHOUT triggering a review PR. Everything in redesign/template/package.json is implicitly approved; add more names here (exact name or prefix ending in *).

a11y._comment: axe-core rule ids that fail the run. Other violations are recorded in design.json as warnings.
